situation: Two old friends who have always disagreed about politics, texting while the news is on.
topic: Immigration: one wants much tighter limits and says so bluntly, the other thinks that is wrong and says so just as bluntly.

text: [link: news story on the new visa changes]
Finally. Should have been done years ago
Saw that headline this morning. Read it properly?
Partly. The numbers they're cutting look right to me. Too many coming in and not enough houses
Houses are the problem, yes. Visa limits aren't the fix for houses though
Doesn't have to be the only fix
Who's it going to hit, though? The nurses we're short of. Half the staff at your pharmacy
Some. We can train more locally. Stop leaning on the cheap-visa crowd
That's not how it works and you know it. Half the people I see at work came on a visa and got stuck in a system that doesn't let them in properly
Dont start on the social work caseload 😏
I'm not starting anything. You started it with "too many coming in"
Ok fair. Still think tighter is right. I dont think the news changes that
Nobody's asking you to change it. Just don't tell me it's obvious
Book club. Friday still on at Kinsey's? Sending the list
[file: book club list 2027.pdf]
Got it. Kinsey's is booked for 7. I'd rather not do the Dunmore again, too long
Agreed, that one took forever. Put it to the group?
Already did. Mostly yes
Ok good
Watching the rest of the news. They've got a clip of someone at the airport crying about their kid, that's the bit that gets me
Sad. Still doesn't mean the policy is wrong
You're going to make me argue at 10pm on a Thursday
Not trying to. Just saying
Ok. Night. Bring the list tomorrow, I'll print mine
Will do

Agreed. Put it in the chat so Mira sees
Will do
